title: Helping a neighbour with her new phone
instructionsHu: Az idős angol szomszédod új okostelefont kapott, és segítséget kér tőled. Tudd meg, mire szeretné használni, magyarázd el, hogyan tud videóhívást indítani, és beszéljétek meg a további segítséget. Minden pontot teljesíts.

situation.context: Your elderly neighbour, Mrs Brown, is an Englishwoman who lives in your block of flats in Budapest. Her son, who lives in Canada, has sent her a new smartphone, but she has never used one before. She knocks on your door and asks for help.
situation.candidateRole: You are her helpful teenage neighbour.
situation.examinerRole: The examiner is Mrs Brown, your elderly neighbour.
goals: Find out what she wants to use the phone for.
Explain in simple steps how she can make a video call to her son.
Recommend one useful app and say why it is good.
Arrange a time when you can practise together again.
situation.examinerOpening: Oh, hello, dear. I'm sorry to bother you, but my son has sent me this new phone, and I have no idea how to use it.

followUpQuestions: Most of all, I'd like to see my son and my grandchildren in Toronto. Can I do that with this thing?
Oh dear, there are so many buttons. What else could this phone be useful for?
You're very kind. Could you show me again some other time?

usefulPhrases.en: What would you like to use it for?

usefulPhrases.hu: Először koppintson erre a zöld ikonra.
Aztán válassza ki a fia nevét.

usefulPhrases.en: Don't worry, it's easier than it looks.
usefulPhrases.hu: Ne aggódjon, könnyebb, mint amilyennek látszik.
Ez az alkalmazás azért hasznos, mert ...

usefulPhrases.en: Shall I come round on Thursday afternoon?

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Oh, hello, dear. I'm sorry to bother you, but my son has sent me this new phone, and I have no idea how to use it.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Hello, Mrs Brown. Don't worry, you're not bothering me at all. What would you like to use the phone for?

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Most of all, I'd like to see my son and my grandchildren in Toronto. Can I do that with this thing?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Yes, of course, you can make a video call. It's quite easy. First, open this messaging app here. Then find your son's name in your contacts and tap it. Finally, tap the small camera symbol at the top, and wait until he answers.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Oh dear, there are so many buttons. What else could this phone be useful for?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I'd recommend BudapestGO, the public transport app. It shows you when the next bus or tram is coming, so you don't have to wait at the stop in the cold.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: That sounds clever. You're very kind. Could you show me again some other time?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Of course. How about Thursday afternoon at five? I finish school at four, so I could come round to your flat after that, and we could practise the video call together.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Thursday at five is perfect. Thank you, dear.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: You're welcome. And if you have any problems before then, just knock on my door.

notes: Kommunikációs cél: a vizsgázó kérdéssel kezdeményez (mire szeretné használni a telefont), egyszerű lépésekben elmagyarázza a videóhívást, indoklással ajánl egy hasznos alkalmazást, végül pontos időpontot egyeztet a gyakorlásra – mind a négy szempont teljesül.
Szókincs: a technika szavai egyszerűek és pontosak, ami egy idős embernek szóló magyarázatnál pont jó (video call, open this app, contacts, tap, camera symbol).
Nyelvhelyesség: a lépéseket felszólító mód és sorrendjelzők (First, Then, Finally) teszik világossá, a javaslat (How about …?) és a feltételes mondat (if you have any problems, just knock) is helyes.
Érdemes megtanulni: „you're not bothering me at all”, „First, … Then, … Finally, …”, „It shows you when the next bus or tram is coming”, „I could come round to your flat”.
